scheme_name: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Incentive for Energy Efficiency
other_conditions: The unit must be engaged in manufacturing or processing of textiles, apparel or technical textiles products.
Production must have started on or after 1 April 2022.
Units may be from private, co‑operative, joint sectors or companies/undertakings owned or managed by the State Government.
The scheme does not apply to industrial units/enterprises.
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution.
The unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 50% (maximum ₹2,00,000) for the cost of an energy audit and up to 25% (maximum ₹10,00,000) for energy‑conservation installation costs.
